title: kekkAI
tagline: AI hijacks your phone calls, screens scams, and onboards you into DeFi — without you even knowing.
description:
kekkAI: The Universal DeFi Gateway for 5.4 Billion Users

1. Autonomous Interception & Intelligent Gateway
kekkAI is the killer app that connects the world’s 5.4 billion mobile users to DeFi without them ever needing to realize it. By leveraging a proprietary engine that operates at the Android app   level (without rootkit/rooted/rooting), we have achieved a "Stealth AI Response" for unknown incoming calls.

Intelligent Interception: The system detects incoming signals in milliseconds and takes over phone notifications. It immediately triggers a secure AI dialogue pipeline in the background.

Proprietary Audio Bridging: By advanced orchestration of existing communication protocols, the caller is seamlessly transitioned into an AI session. This process incorporates optimized timing control algorithms to ensure stable connections across various international carrier environments.

Asymmetric Monitoring Channel: While the AI engages with the caller, a completely independent "Silent Monitoring Channel" is formed for the user. Users can listen to the conversation in real time without their presence ever being detected.

2. Scaling Beyond Voice: A Universal Security Protocol
The architecture of kekkAI is not limited to phone calls. It is a universal security protocol designed to link any everyday human activity to "Attestation" and "Earnings."

Multi-Channel Expansion: The system can easily be plugged into any digital touchpoint, including email phishing detection, biometric data from wearables (e.g., OURA Ring), and IoT sensors.

The Ultimate Killer App: Everyday actions for 5.4 billion people—such as "answering a phone" or "checking an email"—become direct onramps to Web3. It is a platform that drives mass adoption by removing the need for crypto-specific knowledge.

3. Abstracted Trust & Autonomous Reward Distribution
kekkAI fully automates complex Web3 processes, delivering only the economic benefits (real utility) to the user.

Autonomous Reward Mechanism: When reports from multiple users satisfy our decentralized verification logic (Consensus-based trigger), USDC rewards are automatically distributed via smart contracts. This autonomous incentive layer allows users to earn rewards while contributing to the security of the entire community.

EIP-712 Delegated Attestation: Users simply sign locally via an embedded MPC wallet. Our backend relayer pays the gas fees through a "Delegated Attestation" model, providing a completely gasless experience.

ZKP-Ready Architecture: All data is managed in a hashed state (keccak256). The system is designed to be ZKP-ready, ensuring a future-proof path toward a fully anonymous and robust reputation system using Zero-Knowledge Proofs.
how_its_made:
Technical Overview: kekkAI (結界)
1. Autonomous AI Call Interception Pipeline
The core of kekkAI lies in its "Intelligent Call Handling Stack," which operates at the Android application level. By performing advanced intercepts on standard telecommunication flows, we have achieved the world's first "Stealth AI Response."

Event-Driven Interception: the system detects unknown incoming signals in milliseconds, dynamically managing user notifications and initiating background processing.

Proprietary Bridging Logic: Through high-level orchestration of the telephony stack, we use a custom sequence to seamlessly transition the caller into an AI session. This handoff process incorporates optimized timing control algorithms to ensure cross-carrier compatibility.

Secure Session Merging: Utilizing established communication protocols, the system creates a direct dialogue environment between the AI agent and the caller, while simultaneously forming a secure bridge for asymmetric, silent monitoring by the user.

2. Real-time Voice AI & Streaming Stack
To ensure a low-latency conversational experience, we have engineered a high-performance server-side pipeline.

Hybrid Decoding Pipeline: Converts protocol-specific audio data into high-precision formats suitable for AI processing in real time.

LLM Orchestration: Powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash, the implementation is optimized within the Vertex AI environment to maximize model performance based on specific PoC findings.

Intelligent Dialogue Management: The system performs real-time filtering of linguistic fillers and executes context-aware buffering to maintain natural, human-like response intervals.

3. Gasless Attestation & Privacy Infrastructure
We have implemented a seamless trust infrastructure that completely abstracts the complexities of Web3.

EIP-712 Delegated Attestation: By combining local signing via embedded MPC wallets with a background relayer, we utilize "Delegated Attestation." This allows users to record proofs on-chain without ever having to manage gas fees.

ZKP-Ready Architecture: To protect privacy, phone number within database is managed in a hashed state. The architecture ensures a clear upgrade path toward fully anonymous proofs using Zero-Knowledge technology in the future.
auto_summary: An Android app and supporting services that screen unknown calls, run AI voice interactions, and issue on-chain attestations and rewards.
